plugins.description: A reusable multi-agent software development team for Claude Code. Organizes all work through a structured 5-stage pipeline: Discovery & Requirements, Analysis & Planning, Design & Architecture, Development, and Testing/QA. Adapts to any repository and technology stack. Persists state between sessions. Enforces human approval at critical decision points.
